title: Block a wireless device type
summary: Disable a specific type of wireless device, such as Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, using rfkill.

steps.explain: Block devices of a specific type. Replace <TYPE> with the device type you want to disable (e.g., wifi, bluetooth, gps, nfc).

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: The type of wireless device to block (e.g., wifi, bluetooth, gps, nfc).

rollback.explain: Unblock the device type to re-enable it.

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: The type of wireless device to unblock.

warnings: Blocking a device will immediately disconnect any active connections using that device.
